title: web: village view, center view, shared slot panel
criteria:
Write the village and center pages. Vanilla ES modules, DOM built ONLY with h()/clear() from ../dom.js (never innerHTML). Follow the VIEW CONTRACT already implemented in web/js/app.js: each view exports `async function render(el, ctx, params)`; ctx has meta (GET /api/meta: meta.buildings[type] = {name_th, kind, produces, ...}, meta.units[key] = {name_th,...}), state, village (VillageView JSON, see BUILD.md 8.9), villageId, toast(msg, isError), refresh(), navigate(hash). The app re-renders views from fresh ctx.village after refresh(); views must NOT fetch the village themselves. Countdown elements are `h('span', {class:'countdown', 'data-countdown': iso}, countdown(iso))` (app.js updates them every second and refreshes when one hits 0).

== web/js/views/slotpanel.js (shared) ==
`export function queuePanel(ctx)` returns a .panel element listing ctx.village.build_queue: one .list-row per entry: '<name_th of type from ctx.meta.buildings> -> เลเวล <target_level>' and the countdown span; heading 'คิวก่อสร้าง' and a muted 'ไม่มีการก่อสร้าง' row when empty; also text `ช่องก่อสร้าง: <n>/<queue_limit>`.
`export async function openSlotPanel(el, ctx, slot)` removes any existing `.bottom-sheet` inside el, fetches `api.get('/villages/' + ctx.villageId + '/slots/' + slot)` (SlotView: {slot, current, upgrade, options}), then appends a `.bottom-sheet` to el containing: a close button 'ปิด' (removes the sheet), a title (current building name_th and 'เลเวล N', or 'ช่องว่าง #<slot>' when current is null); when `upgrade` is not null: a block with the four resource costs (labels ไม้ หิน เหล็ก อาหาร, numbers via fmtNum; show a cost value in the `.negative` class when ctx.village.resources of that kind is lower), the build time via fmtDuration(time_s), the missing requirements (each as a `.negative` line) and a primary button 'อัปเกรดเป็นเลเวล <current.level+1>' that is disabled when `upgrade.affordable` is false; when `options` is non-empty (empty slot): one block per option with name_th, costs, time, missing list and a button 'สร้าง'. Clicking a build/upgrade button disables it, calls `api.post('/villages/' + ctx.villageId + '/build', {slot, type})` (type = current.type for an upgrade, option.type for a new building), then ctx.toast('เริ่มก่อสร้างแล้ว') and `await ctx.refresh()`; on ApiError: ctx.toast(err.message, true) and re-enable the button. If the slot is currently being built (an entry of ctx.village.build_queue has this slot) show the note 'กำลังก่อสร้างอยู่' and disable the buttons. Errors from the slot fetch -> ctx.toast(message, true).

== web/js/views/village.js (route #/ and #/v/:id) ==
From ctx.village: heading with the village name and a small button 'เปลี่ยนชื่อ' (window.prompt with the current name; on a non-empty answer api.patch('/villages/' + id, {name}) then ctx.refresh(); errors toast); a rates row 'ผลิต/ชม.' showing the 4 rates with fmtNum (food rate in `.negative` when < 0); the 18 field slots (slots 1..18 from village.buildings) in a `.field-grid` (6 columns x 3 rows): each cell is `.slot` with an extra class from meta.buildings[type].produces ('wood'|'stone'|'iron'|'food'), the level number in `.slot-level` and a short label (name_th) in `.slot-label`; add class 'building' when the slot has an entry in village.build_queue; clicking a cell calls openSlotPanel(el, ctx, slot); then queuePanel(ctx); a 'ทหารในหมู่บ้าน' panel listing troops_home as '<unit name_th> x<count>' or 'ไม่มีทหาร'; a 'ทัพ' panel listing village.movements as rows: direction 'out' -> arrow '→', 'in' -> '←'; mission label (attack 'โจมตี', raid 'ปล้น', scout 'สอดแนม', reinforce 'ส่งทัพเสริม', settle 'ตั้งหมู่บ้านใหม่', return 'กลับบ้าน'), the target coordinates '(x, y)', the units list when units is not null, a countdown to arrive_at, and class `negative` when hostile; 'ไม่มีทัพเคลื่อนที่' when empty.

== web/js/views/center.js (route #/center and #/v/:id/center) ==
Heading 'ใจกลางหมู่บ้าน'; queuePanel(ctx); then a `.center-grid` (4 columns) with the slots 19..40 (22 cells; village.buildings entries with slot >= 19): each cell is a `.slot` showing name_th (or 'ว่าง' with class 'empty' when type is null) and the level (when level > 0 or type not null); add class 'building' when under construction; click -> openSlotPanel(el, ctx, slot). Do not implement troop training UI.

== web/css/style.css ==
APPEND at the END a new section '/* village + center + slot panel */' with any extra styles you need (cost rows, muted text, rates row, panel headings). Do not modify existing rules.
notes:
- Import helpers: `import { h, clear } from '../dom.js'; import { api, ApiError } from '../api.js'; import { fmtNum, fmtDuration } from '../format.js'; import { countdown } from '../clock.js';`
- For the resource labels use these Thai words exactly: ไม้, หิน, เหล็ก, อาหาร (resource keys wood, stone, iron, food).
- Keep all user-visible Thai strings EXACTLY as written in the criteria above (copy them letter by letter); do not invent other Thai words; if you need one more label, reuse the closest string above.
- A `.bottom-sheet` already has CSS in style.css (fixed above the bottom nav); a hidden state class exists but removing the element is fine.
- Don't re-render the whole page from inside click handlers; call ctx.refresh().
- Run the test_cmd (node --check on every js file) and fix syntax errors.
